mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past three months compresses discount rates for equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS has declined over the past three months, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the unemployment rate above 6.5% over the past month signals deteriorating labor market conditions, which typically precedes a decline in corporate earnings and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE > 6.5, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in the federal funds rate and unemployment rate signals a monetary tightening cycle coinciding with labor market weakness, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS rises > 0.1pp and UNRATE rises > 0.1pp in 1 month
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of triggered instances, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In periods of high housing market activity (HOUST above 1500 thousand units), a decline in housing starts over the past month signals weakening residential demand, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when HOUST > 1500 and HOUST declines, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in retail sales (RSAFS) over the past three months indicates strong consumer demand, which typically leads to higher corporate revenues and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when RSAFS has increased over the past three months, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production below 100 (index) over the past month signals a contraction in manufacturing output, which typically precedes a slowdown in economic growth and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO < 100, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) and federal funds rate signals an aggressive monetary tightening cycle in response to inflation, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL rises > 0.2pp and FEDFUNDS rises > 0.1pp in 1 month
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of triggered instances, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In periods of high unemployment (UNRATE > 6.5%), a decline in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) over the past month signals worsening labor market conditions, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE > 6.5% and PAYEMS declines, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.
